reviewedLeads.summary: [Accepted receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L81-secondary-recoil-inputs.json): the selected paths resolve `WPM_UBL_M26DB` object 16 and `WPM_UBL_M320HE` object 10 through `Field_775480e0` imports to the exact `Class_539cff9b` GunSway owners. The 14-field M4A1 control and all 28 target operands are raw-checked; exact root and nested descriptors match. M26 values per aim are amount/direction/variation 3/-10/12; M320 HE amounts are hip 5 and ADS 2, with direction/variation zero. Multipliers are 1 and exponents 0.

The [L82/L84 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L82-L84-secondary-spread-inputs.json) records both target GS selectors as UINT32 zero. The common-table candidate association points to HDA row 0 candidates 7.400000095/9.25 and moving-ZDA row 0 candidate 0.680000007; stationary hip/ADS IncreasePerShot is 1/1 for M26DB and 0.5/0.5 for M320 HE. The M433/HK433 selector, named-minimum and increment controls pass.

The [L82/L84 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L82-L84-secondary-spread-inputs.json) records local MinAngle/MaxAngle pairs for rows 0/1/9/10: M26DB 1.5/1.5, 2/2, 0.5/0.5, 1.2/1.2; M320 HE 1/7, 1.5/7, 0.1/0.3, 0.3/0.7. The M4A1 descriptor-based control passed. Its first strict check compared rounded 0.05 with raw 0.050000000745 at offset 2200; the corrected exact-byte/offset guard passed before target data was read.

[Accepted receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L83-secondary-recoil-recovery.json): the same selected `GS_M26Mass` / `GS_M320HE` owners as L81 share `Class_539cff9b` and root key `1db15dc58e7cbe6b406d78236eb07b68`; 20 hip/ADS FLOAT32 words are raw-checked. M26 per-aim duration/factor/exponent/time-exponent/offset are 0/70/0.600000024/3/0.0010000000475; M320 HE values are 0/3.599999905/0.800000012/2/0.0010000000475. The M4A1 same-type control passes 10/10 in both aims. Names use prior `FIELD_MAP.md` and L13 duration evidence; there is no fresh local GRX name join.

The [L86/L87 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L86-L87-secondary-spread-protection.json) records the exact HDA_Weapons and ZDA_Moving_Weapons roots. The post-control direct index has 63 distinct caller files and 126 reference sites; the selected M4A1 GS imports both roots. Raw checks show the fixed M26Mass and M320 HE GS owners have null words for both tables at offsets 1848/1880, and the exact direct index has no rows for either owner.

The [L86/L87 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L86-L87-secondary-spread-protection.json) records the DP12 named `Shot.DamageProtectionMultiplierIndex` control (owner offset 640; GRX_Weapons value offset 1742380), then transfers that exact child/hash name through matching root and nested Shot descriptors. Ordinary selected M26DB stores signed INT32 0 at offset 1168 (`00000000`); M320 HE stores -1 at offset 592 (`ffffffff`).

Hip and ADS each store duration 0, decrease factor 3.6, exponent 0.8, time exponent 2 and offset 0.001; native meaning remains unresolved.

HE stores projectile `InitialSpeed=250` and TTL 15. L71B joins projectile object 1 to Explosion object 7 (`Class_9966532d`), with named `BlastDamage=120` and `DamageMultiplier=1`; `layoutAmbiguous` remains. [Accepted receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L75-m320-explosion-naming-limit.json): the `BlastDamage` control reproduces on the actual M320 owner. Two hashes have 24 exact name pairs each (`BlastRadius`, `ShockwaveRadius`) on other anchors, but no paired owner body matches the pinned Head/descriptor. These names already appear in `FIELD_MAP.md` and are not an L75 discovery. `Field_a6f614aa` has no pair in this registry.

[L76 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L76-m320-he-firing-inputs.json): selected `PrimaryFire_M320` stores `Shot.InitialSpeed=[0,0,63]`; this is separate from projectile `InitialSpeed=250` and TTL 15. The named primary M4A1 `Shot.InitialSpeed.z=590` control matches the site bullet velocity. FireLogic stores mode 0 (labelled single by `FIELD_MAP`), main/burst/single rates 100/550/-1 and one reload row; the two layouts and native precedence remain unresolved. [L76B arithmetic](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L76B-m320-he-capture-feasibility.json) gives non-overlapping 20 m timing intervals only under explicit assumptions.

The [L79 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L79-m320-explosion-name-limits.json) records the passing M320 HE `BlastDamage=120` control and zero pairs for `Field_0df20cb3` and `Field_920ff0be` in one pinned GRX_Gadgets scan (1,618 anchors, 5,726 entries). [Receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L85-m320-shockwave-input.json): the selected HE and TB Explosion object 7 owners each store FLOAT32 `Field_3ef01f58` as 1.0 (raw bytes `0000803f` at offsets 1776/1824). `FIELD_MAP.md` already maps the hash to `ShockwaveDamage` for `Class_9966532d`. Each exact same-owner GRX_Gadgets anchor has seven pairs and no pair for this field.

The [L86/L87 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L86-L87-secondary-spread-protection.json) records the exact HDA_Weapons and ZDA_Moving_Weapons roots. The post-control direct index has 63 distinct caller files and 126 reference sites; the selected M4A1 GS imports both roots. Raw checks show the fixed M26Mass and M320 HE GS owners have null words for both tables at offsets 1848/1880, and the exact direct index has no rows for either owner.

The [L86/L87 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L86-L87-secondary-spread-protection.json) records the DP12 named `Shot.DamageProtectionMultiplierIndex` control (owner offset 640; GRX_Weapons value offset 1742380), then transfers that exact child/hash name through matching root and nested Shot descriptors. Ordinary selected M26DB stores signed INT32 0 at offset 1168 (`00000000`); M320 HE stores -1 at offset 592 (`ffffffff`).

The [L88 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L88-m26-m320-configured-ammo-counts.json) records DP12_WB object 1 as the passing same-class known-answer control: `MagazineCapacity=16` at offset 960 (`10000000`) and `NumberOfMagazines=6` at offset 964 (`06000000`). Exact matching root class key `503dde81ed5cf4d154423f8a5b58e439` / descriptor 515 (`35259f6b`) and nested Ammo descriptor 547 (`598cc52c`) support the selected M26DB object 7 counts 5/2 at offsets 1488/1492 and M320 HE `PrimaryFire_M320` object 1 counts 1/2 at 912/916. All four selected words are signed INT32 and raw-checked; reused L73/L71 route controls passed 12/12 and 8/8.

reviewedLeads.summary: [Accepted partial source receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L73-m26db-source-profile.json): ordinary `WPM_UBL_M26DB` has internal M26 buckshot base and Dragon's Breath replacement-projectile paths, not necessarily separate menu choices. Both exact projectile owners have four typed FLOAT32 fields named through the corrected M4A1 owner control. Base `StartDamage`/`EndDamage`/`DamageFalloffStartDistance`/`DamageFalloffEndDistance` values are 8.4/2/6/25; Dragon's Breath values are 5/2.5/5/15. Both direct-hit and second-curve pointers are null; this is not a zero-damage finding. The corrected M4A1 anchor is `Field_0758d41c/Field_6b28f68f` (GUID `6a50ee98-9509-4143-a314-f441a0705de6`); the earlier four-null child GUID output was a reporting omission. The [child GUID correction](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L73-registry-child-guid-reporting-correction.json) records the four exported GUIDs; names, values and anchor remain unchanged.

[Accepted receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L80-m26db-trajectory-inputs.json): selected `WPM_UBL_M26DB` object 7 stores inline `Shot.InitialSpeed=[0,0,400]`, linked to internal `PD_M26Mass` and `PD_M26MassDragonbreath` records. Both store `InitialSpeed=350`, `Gravity=-9.8100004196167` and `Drag=0`; `TimeToLive` is 0.5 and 0.10000000149011612 respectively. The inline firing vector and projectile speeds remain separate inputs, and the two profiles are not asserted as separate menu choices.

[Accepted receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L81-secondary-recoil-inputs.json): the selected paths resolve `WPM_UBL_M26DB` object 16 and `WPM_UBL_M320HE` object 10 through `Field_775480e0` imports to the exact `Class_539cff9b` GunSway owners. The 14-field M4A1 control and all 28 target operands are raw-checked; exact root and nested descriptors match. M26 values per aim are amount/direction/variation 3/-10/12; M320 HE amounts are hip 5 and ADS 2, with direction/variation zero. Multipliers are 1 and exponents 0.

The [L82/L84 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L82-L84-secondary-spread-inputs.json) records both target GS selectors as UINT32 zero. The common-table candidate association points to HDA row 0 candidates 7.400000095/9.25 and moving-ZDA row 0 candidate 0.680000007; stationary hip/ADS IncreasePerShot is 1/1 for M26DB and 0.5/0.5 for M320 HE. The M433/HK433 selector, named-minimum and increment controls pass.

The [L82/L84 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L82-L84-secondary-spread-inputs.json) records local MinAngle/MaxAngle pairs for rows 0/1/9/10: M26DB 1.5/1.5, 2/2, 0.5/0.5, 1.2/1.2; M320 HE 1/7, 1.5/7, 0.1/0.3, 0.3/0.7. The M4A1 descriptor-based control passed. Its first strict check compared rounded 0.05 with raw 0.050000000745 at offset 2200; the corrected exact-byte/offset guard passed before target data was read.

[Accepted receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L83-secondary-recoil-recovery.json): the same selected `GS_M26Mass` / `GS_M320HE` owners as L81 share `Class_539cff9b` and root key `1db15dc58e7cbe6b406d78236eb07b68`; 20 hip/ADS FLOAT32 words are raw-checked. M26 per-aim duration/factor/exponent/time-exponent/offset are 0/70/0.600000024/3/0.0010000000475; M320 HE values are 0/3.599999905/0.800000012/2/0.0010000000475. The M4A1 same-type control passes 10/10 in both aims. Names use prior `FIELD_MAP.md` and L13 duration evidence; there is no fresh local GRX name join.

The [L86/L87 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L86-L87-secondary-spread-protection.json) records the exact HDA_Weapons and ZDA_Moving_Weapons roots. The post-control direct index has 63 distinct caller files and 126 reference sites; the selected M4A1 GS imports both roots. Raw checks show the fixed M26Mass and M320 HE GS owners have null words for both tables at offsets 1848/1880, and the exact direct index has no rows for either owner.

The [L86/L87 receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L86-L87-secondary-spread-protection.json) records the DP12 named `Shot.DamageProtectionMultiplierIndex` control (owner offset 640; GRX_Weapons value offset 1742380), then transfers that exact child/hash name through matching root and nested Shot descriptors. Ordinary selected M26DB stores signed INT32 0 at offset 1168 (`00000000`); M320 HE stores -1 at offset 592 (`ffffffff`).

Five remaining M26 payload/state roots raw-verified; three ordinary candidate parents select ordinary/Dragonbreath sources, without remaining-payload joins; hotfix owner identities block automatic historical field-name transfer.

reviewedLeads.summary: [Accepted partial source receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L73-m26db-source-profile.json): ordinary `WPM_UBL_M26DB` has internal M26 buckshot base and Dragon's Breath replacement-projectile paths, not necessarily separate menu choices. Both exact projectile owners have four typed FLOAT32 fields named through the corrected M4A1 owner control. Base `StartDamage`/`EndDamage`/`DamageFalloffStartDistance`/`DamageFalloffEndDistance` values are 8.4/2/6/25; Dragon's Breath values are 5/2.5/5/15. Both direct-hit and second-curve pointers are null; this is not a zero-damage finding. The corrected M4A1 anchor is `Field_0758d41c/Field_6b28f68f` (GUID `6a50ee98-9509-4143-a314-f441a0705de6`); the earlier four-null child GUID output was a reporting omission. The [child GUID correction](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L73-registry-child-guid-reporting-correction.json) records the four exported GUIDs; names, values and anchor remain unchanged.

[Accepted receipt](../../reference-data/provenance/frosty-2026-09-26-L80-m26db-trajectory-inputs.json): selected `WPM_UBL_M26DB` object 7 stores inline `Shot.InitialSpeed=[0,0,400]`, linked to internal `PD_M26Mass` and `PD_M26MassDragonbreath` records. Both store `InitialSpeed=350`, `Gravity=-9.8100004196167` and `Drag=0`; `TimeToLive` is 0.5 and 0.10000000149011612 respectively. The inline firing vector and projectile speeds remain separate inputs, and the two profiles are not asserted as separate menu choices.
